annotations.text:
START HERE — THE WALKABLE PROTOTYPE
One window, all ten stages of the Founder journey, with working navigation: click the rail, use Back/Next, or use the controls inside each screen. Working navigation, no backend — nothing dispatches, nothing spends.

The idea it walks is the Founder's real one, typed on 1 Sep: "the current UI so much verbose... like an ellipse where we can track flow". Internal tooling, so depth is Light and the competitor sections are honestly empty.

THE JOURNEY, LAID OUT — the same ten screens the prototype mounts, side by side in order, so the whole arc is readable without clicking. Each one's own controls work here too (expanders, arm-then-confirm, the reconsider box); only the moves BETWEEN stages need the prototype.

THE CENTREPIECE — one page, split in two only so the rail can jump to it. Concise layer: the ten questions, all answered, readable in about two minutes. Every "show the working" holds evidence for a decision you can already make, never part of the decision itself.

THE CONSEQUENTIAL ACTION — arm (dispatches nothing) then confirm (the only filled button that spends). The failure state is drawn below it, because this project has already shipped one success message over a no-op.

REFERENCE SHEETS — left: the five-voice grammar that solves the central problem (what I said · what you think I meant · what you think of it · what you recommend · what I approved). Middle: the honest states, drawn rather than described. Right: the Full-depth layer, every label slot shown, every value a marked placeholder.

NOTHING INVENTED. The directive bans invented competitor information and a mockup is not exempt, so every value on this sheet is a bracketed structural placeholder. The standing line is rendered exactly as it would appear today: "Research has not been performed; all entries below are company inference or unknown."
